entries.back_en: We'll wait until dark, then we'll attack. We should be able to handle the guards easily.
Huh? Wait a minute! You're X, aren't you? The Chief of the Worens!?
It really is him! He's wanted by the Ludian Kingdom! If we let him through, we'll be in trouble!
It's okay... Besides, I was thinking...
Don't think you can get away with what you did!
Well, they say that somewhere in the woods on the road to Shikk, there's a tree that can talk! Just like you or me! I heard it became aware because it's been alive for so long!
Even if you h-hit me, you still won't be able to get past the gate! Now g-go away and leave me alone... Please?
entries.note: 'knock me out' rendered as 'me bata' (hit me), losing the knockout sense.
